mapper.select: SELECT m.employee_id, e.name, m.employment_type, m.hire_date, e.retired_at, m.note FROM hd_comfort_member m JOIN hd_employee e ON e.id = m.employee_id WHERE e.job_type = 'DRIVER' ORDER BY e.name
SELECT employee_id, start_date, end_date FROM hd_comfort_contract ORDER BY start_date, employee_id
SELECT id, employee_id, used_on, memo, created_by FROM hd_comfort_use WHERE used_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY used_on, id

SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name, e.retired_at, m.employment_type, m.hire_date, m.note FROM hd_employee e LEFT JOIN hd_comfort_member m ON m.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.job_type = 'DRIVER' ORDER BY (m.employee_id IS NULL) DESC, e.name
SELECT name FROM hd_employee WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND job_type = 'DRIVER' FOR UPDATE
SELECT employment_type FROM hd_comfort_member WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_comfort_member (employee_id, employment_type, hire_date, note) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{employmentType}, #{hireDate}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (employee_id) DO UPDATE SET employment_type = EXCLUDED.employment_type, hire_date = EXCLUDED.hire_date, note = EXCLUDED.note, updated_at = now()
INSERT INTO hd_comfort_use (employee_id, used_on, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{usedOn}, #{memo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id, start_date, end_date FROM hd_comfort_contract WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hd_comfort_contract (employee_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hd_comfort_contract WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND start_date = #{startDate}
